changes: Kozu Spectrum: twelve accent families on Tailwind CSS v4 lightness and chroma with 2 to 4 degree Kozu hue offsets; Graphite neutral; status ramps on Tailwind green, amber, red and sky. Accent modes renamed (Blue to Cobalt and so on) with mode IDs kept; Vermilion, Citron, Lagoon and Orchid added.

Every hard-coded Tailwind and slate color across the 39 earlier boards, components, gradients, shadows and platform variables moved to Spectrum or Graphite values; no Tailwind v3 hex remains in fills or strokes.

Borders removed where they were decorative: device and window outlines (now neutral layered shadows), swatch outlines (tonal well), fader outlines (knob shadow), footer and wearable header rules. Kept: icon strokes, unchecked checkbox and radio outlines, pro-tool dividers.
App theme overrides card removed from Foundations at the owner's request; replaced by a live Kozu Spectrum card.
New pages 39 to 45: Kozu Spectrum, Web foundations, Web components (13 web masters, 31 icon masters), Portfolio, Landing page (Paperboy), Ecommerce, Docs and articles.
web/kozu.css, web/kozu.tailwind.css and web/README.md for websites.

palette.base: Tailwind CSS v4 lightness and chroma per step, with Kozu hue offsets

closenessToTailwind.note: OKLab distance from each step to the same step of its Tailwind v4 family

focusChangeMinimum.note: dark focus pairs measure 4.9:1 or more

cvdSets.note: Smallest OKLab difference across the light fill and text roles, under normal vision and Machado 2009 protan, deutan and tritan simulation.

palette.history: An earlier 0.6 draft used an equal-contrast ladder with hues placed between Tailwind and Apple hues (independently audited: 132/132 contrast pairs passed). The owner then asked for the Spectrum to sit closer to Tailwind, which produced the current version.

automatedChecks.geometryGuard: passed on the 46-board document (no concentricity, centering or border-state issues)

websiteTextContrast.method: each text layer against its composited backdrop, WCAG 2 thresholds, all website frames

reviews.verdict: not approved on the first draft: CVD collapses, near-Tailwind roles, warning/danger tie
reviews.resolution: hue optimization, CVD-checked sets, warning lightness split; later superseded by the Tailwind-aligned version

reviews.verdict: not ready: cropped TV tile, stretched buttons packed left, three-line phone headline
reviews.resolution: portfolio and landing rebuilt: one tile ratio on a tonal ground with whole works visible, distinct works, quiet nav action, aligned 12-column grid, centered and end-slot button content, two-line headlines, real blocked-sender row, no-wrap code, correct icons

reviews.verdict: first pass not ready (reduced transparency lost in dark, dark focus under 3:1); re-audit of v2: CSS scoping, Tailwind syntax and 187/187 hex parity clean, 298 contrast pairs checked
reviews.resolution: light-dark() scoping with an @supports light fallback, theme-aware focus tokens (light minimum 3.25:1, dark 4.92:1), @theme inline, contrast-safe link role, heading clamp set to half the display from 768 up, supported-pair wording narrowed, Tailwind leftovers replaced. Native app focus keeps platform focus plus tone and lift; the 3:1 claim is scoped to the web.

limits: Static editable design kit; not production app code
Runtime screen reader, 200% text scaling, hardware blur and remote/watch behavior need platform validation
Widget dimensions are representative; the host supplies exact bounds
Apple watch faces are concepts; implement supported app UI and complication families
Website mockups are static; browser keyboard focus, zoom, reduced motion and real fonts need a built site to verify.
